title: Stability of Quadratically Regularized Optimal Transport
summary: Quadratically regularized optimal transport (QOT) is a sparse alternative to entropic optimal transport. We develop a quantitative stability theory for QOT under perturbations of the marginals, the transport cost function, and the regularization parameter. The centerpiece is an $L^\infty$-stability result for the dual potentials. Starting from an error bound in an $L^2$-space that varies with the marginals, we use a self-bound for the potentials to derive a local $L^\infty$-Lipschitz bound that is uniform over marginals.
